# schema

Generate a migration schema from Dataverse metadata

## Usage

```
ppds data schema [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--disable-plugins` |  | `bool` |  | Set disableplugins=true on all entities |
| `--entities` | `-e` | `String[]` |  | Entity logical names to include (comma-separated or multiple -e flags) |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--exclude-attributes` |  | `String[]` |  | Exclude these attributes (blacklist, comma-separated) |
| `--filter` |  | `String[]` |  | SQL-like filter per entity. Format: entity:expression (e.g., "account:statecode = 0"). Repeatable. |
| `--include-attributes` | `-a` | `String[]` |  | Only include these attributes (whitelist, comma-separated or multiple flags) |
| `--include-audit-fields` |  | `bool` |  | Include audit fields (createdon, createdby, modifiedon, modifiedby, overriddencreatedon) |
| `--output` | `-o` | `FileInfo` |  | Output schema file path |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Profile name(s). For high-throughput pooling, specify multiple Application User profiles comma-separated (e.g., app1,app2,app3) - each profile multiplies API quota. |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
